message: No raw verifier execution evidence for any of the 46 proof artifacts. All are PENDING_FORMAL_EXECUTION. No verus/cargo-kani/cargo-flux/cargo-test/cargo-fuzz output captured. Inspection is not verification.

message: GOD RULE 2 violation: All Verus proofs define types and exec fns within the proof file only. Zero requires/ensures annotations on production code at crates/vb_runtime/src/. Proofs bind spec to exec both defined in the same file — vacuum proof pattern.
required_fix: Move requires/ensures into production Rust code at the cited source paths. Prove the proof-file model is equivalent to production implementation via explicit bridge.

message: All Kani harnesses define local functions (compute_deadline, matches_authority, etc.) instead of calling production code from vb_runtime/vb_core. kani::cover!(true, ...) always fires — zero informational value. Harnesses prove properties of their own code, not the production implementation.
required_fix: Rewrite harnesses to use and call actual production functions from vb_runtime and vb_core crates. Replace cover!(true,...) with conditional coverage assertions.

message: FABRICATION: All Flux refinement files document Flux annotations in doc comments only. Actual modules are empty (pub mod X_refinements {}). No #[flux_rs::sig], #[flux_rs::refined_by], or #[flux_rs::invariant] attributes exist anywhere. Tests are standard Rust #[test] functions on local code. These are not Flux verification artifacts.

message: Loom models are toy: PS-001 spawns 4 threads on independent immutable data (no shared mutable state, no interleaving). PS-010 is single-threaded. No production synchronization (mutex, channel, concurrent HashMap) modeled. #[cfg(not(loom))] tests contain assert!(true).
required_fix: Model actual production synchronization with meaningful concurrent interleavings or create explicit waiver with justification.

message: Fuzz target defines local validate_slot_value and validate_slot_kind functions. Does not import or exercise vb_core::workflow::CompiledNodeKind or vb_runtime::shard::helpers::timer_registration_required. Fuzzes its own validation, not the production slot parsing boundary.

message: Multiple Verus lemmas have empty bodies {} or bodies that merely assert the requires clause. lemma_overflow_detected body is assert(tick+duration>u64_max()) which is already in requires. lemma_missing_never_authorizes has empty body. lemma_wrong_gen_rejected, lemma_wrong_deadline_rejected, lemma_wrong_kind_rejected all have empty bodies — proves nothing non-trivial.
required_fix: Lemmas must prove non-trivial consequences. Remove tautological lemmas or give them actual proof content.

message: Proof strategy is 4 lines: heading plus two sentences. No defense-in-depth layering, no dependency ordering, no blast-radius analysis, no verifier-staging plan.
required_fix: Expand with layered defense reasoning, verifier dependency ordering, and staged execution plan.

message: All 46 obligation rows share identical blanket assumption text. Never defines model_bounds per-seed. Assumes 'standard library correctness' without enumerating trusted functions. Claims 'no external I/O' in scope of a bead about replacing Instant::now() — an external I/O boundary.
